title: Pure Reactor
summary: Greiger's Reactor archetype is a DARK Machine burn, destruction, and Synchro-boss strategy built around Summon Reactor SK (Level 5), Trap Reactor Y FI (Level 4), Spell Reactor RE (Level 3), their combined boss Flying Fortress SKY FIRE (Level 8, 3000 ATK), and their Level 8 DARK Machine Synchro carrier Dark Flattop! Each Reactor punishes your opponent for playing Yu-Gi-Oh!—burning them for 800 damage and destroying their card the first time they Summon a monster (Summon Reactor SK), activate a Spell (Spell Reactor RE), or activate a Trap (Trap Reactor Y FI) each turn! Normal Summon Black Salvo to revive Trap Reactor Y FI from your GY and Synchro Summon Level 8 Dark Flattop, which revives any Reactor monster or Flying Fortress SKY FIRE from your GY every single turn!

allow.Black Salvo: Core Level 3 DARK Machine Tuner: when Normal Summoned, targets 1 Level 4 DARK Machine monster (Trap Reactor Y FI!) in your GY and Special Summons it in Defense Position—tuning with Level 5 Summon Reactor SK into Level 8 Dark Flattop or with Level 4 Trap Reactor into Level 7 Clear Wing Synchro Dragon!
allow.Scrap Recycler: Level 3 EARTH Machine starter that sends Trap Reactor Y FI, Spell Reactor RE, or Machina Fortress directly from your Deck to the GY on Normal or Special Summon.
allow.Machina Gearframe: Level 4 EARTH Machine Union monster that searches Machina Fortress on Normal Summon and equips to protect your Reactor monsters from destruction.
allow.Machina Fortress: Level 7 EARTH Machine (2500 ATK) that discards Machine monsters totaling Level 8+ (such as Summon Reactor SK + Spell Reactor RE) to Special Summon itself from hand or GY.
allow.Clockwork Night: Continuous Spell that turns all monsters on the field into Machines, boosts your Reactor Machines by 500 ATK, weakens opponent's monsters by 500 ATK, and banishes from GY to search Scrap Recycler.
allow.Back to the Front: Normal Trap that revives Summon Reactor SK, Trap Reactor Y FI, Spell Reactor RE, or Dark Flattop from your GY in Defense Position during the opponent's turn.
allow.Clear Wing Synchro Dragon: Level 7 Synchro summoned using Level 3 Black Salvo + Level 4 Trap Reactor Y FI that negates Level 5+ monster effects and targeting monster effects.
allow.Gear Gigant X: Rank 4 Machine Xyz that detaches 1 material to add Black Salvo, Spell Reactor RE, or Trap Reactor Y FI from your Deck or GY to your hand!
allow.Platinum Gadget: Link-2 Machine that Special Summons Trap Reactor Y FI or Spell Reactor RE directly from your hand.
allow.Clockwork Knight: Link-1 EARTH Machine summoned using Scrap Recycler that searches Clockwork Night and tributes a Machine to revive Scrap Recycler.

main: Summon Reactor SK

Level 5 DARK Machine (2000 ATK): burns for 800 damage the first time an opponent summons a monster each turn, can negate that monster's attack, and sends itself + Trap Reactor Y FI + Spell Reactor RE to summon Flying Fortress SKY FIRE!
Trap Reactor Y FI
Level 4 DARK Machine (800 ATK / 1800 DEF; prime revival target for Black Salvo!): destroys the first Trap Card your opponent activates each turn and burns them for 800 damage!
Spell Reactor RE
Level 3 DARK Machine (1200 ATK / 900 DEF): destroys the first Spell Card your opponent activates each turn and burns them for 800 damage!
Flying Fortress SKY FIRE

Signature Level 8 WIND Machine boss (3000 ATK / 2500 DEF): Special Summoned by Summon Reactor SK; sends 1 card from hand to GY to destroy 1 card your opponent controls, and destroys 1 monster they summon or 1 Spell/Trap they Set and burns for 800!
Black Salvo
Core Level 3 DARK Machine Tuner: revives Level 4 DARK Machine Trap Reactor Y FI from your GY when Normal Summoned, enabling Level 7 Clear Wing or Level 8 Dark Flattop!
Scrap Recycler
Sends Trap Reactor Y FI, Summon Reactor SK, or Machina Fortress from your Deck to the GY on Normal or Special Summon.
Machina Gearframe
Searches Machina Fortress on Normal Summon and overlays with Trap Reactor Y FI into Rank 4 Gear Gigant X.
Machina Fortress
Discards high-level Machines to Special Summon itself from hand or GY.
Clockwork Night
Boosts all your Reactor Machines by 500 ATK, drops all opponent's monsters by 500 ATK, and banishes from GY to search Scrap Recycler.
Back to the Front
Revives Summon Reactor SK, Trap Reactor Y FI, Spell Reactor RE, or Dark Flattop from your GY in Defense Position.
Fake Explosion
Signature Reactor Trap: activates when an opponent's monster declares an attack; monsters cannot be destroyed by that battle, and Special Summons 1 'Summon Reactor SK' from your hand or GY!
